license.note: The dedication applies to the schema file distributed in this package, so that it can be embedded in other software without attribution obligations. The prose specification at spec/v1.0/spec.md is a separate work and remains under CC BY 4.0.

policy: This package consumes the specification; it does not define it. The vendored file is a byte-for-byte copy of the canonical v1.0 schema and is never edited here. Agent Manifest v1.0 is frozen, so any difference between this checksum and the canonical source is drift and is treated as an incident: the file is not re-vendored until the divergence is explained upstream. A future schema version is added as an additional file under a new minor version of this package, never by mutating this one.
